title: UseMemo
markdown: --- title: "UseMemo" --- > **Learn more:** [Hooks](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/guides/hooks), [Effects](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/guides/effects) ## Overloads [#overloads] - [`UseMemo(Func, object[])`](#usememot1funct1-object) - [`UseMemo(Func, T2)`](#usememot1-t2funct1-t2) - [`UseMemo(Func, T2, T3)`](#usememot1-t2-t3funct1-t2-t3) - [`UseMemo(Func, T2, T3, T4)`](#usememot1-t2-t3-t4funct1-t2-t3-t4) ## `UseMemo(Func, object[])` [#usememot1funct1-object] `method` _cref_: `M:Microsoft.UI.Reactor.Core.RenderContext.UseMemo``1(System.Func{``0},System.Object[])` ### Summary [#summary] Memoizes a computed value, recomputing only when dependencies change. ## `UseMemo(Func, T2)` [#usememot1-t2funct1-t2] `method` _cref_: `M:Microsoft.UI.Reactor.Core.RenderContext.UseMemo``2(System.Func{``0},``1)` ### Summary [#summary_1] Single-dependency `UseMemo` overload that avoids the `params object[]` allocation (and value-type boxing) on the deps-unchanged path. Recomputes only when `d1` changes. ### Discussion [#discussion] If `d1`'s compile-time type is an array of reference types (e.g. `string[]`), it is treated as a dependency list and compared element-wise — matching the `params object[]` overload — not as a single reference-compared value. A dependency whose static type is not an array is always compared as one value, even if its runtime value happens to be an array. ## `UseMemo(Func, T2, T3)` [#usememot1-t2-t3funct1-t2-t3] `method` _cref_: `M:Microsoft.UI.Reactor.Core.RenderContext.UseMemo``3(System.Func{``0},``1,``2)` ### Summary [#summary_2] Two-dependency `UseMemo` overload that avoids the `params object[]` allocation on the deps-unchanged path. ## `UseMemo(Func, T2, T3, T4)` [#usememot1-t2-t3-t4funct1-t2-t3-t4] `method` _cref_: `M:Microsoft.UI.Reactor.Core.RenderContext.UseMemo``4(System.Func{``0},``1,``2,``3)` ### Summary [#summary_3] Three-dependency `UseMemo` overload that avoids the `params object[]` allocation on the deps-unchanged path. ## Featured in [#featured-in] - [Hooks](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/guides/hooks)
